programme.desc: After Joker (Stephen Chow) goes back 500 years, he runs into myriad oddball characters, including the Longevity Monk.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: Another Me
programme.desc: One day, Constable Li Mao accidentally discovers that he looks exactly like the prince. Wanting a better life for himself, Li agrees to switch places with the prince, who wants freedom.

programme.title: Love Is The Only Answer
programme.desc: When a flash of her groom's infidelity is revealed at their wedding, Bo cancels the entire affair. However, within a year, he comes knocking on her door again.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: The first Bollywood movie made in Hong Kong, it is about an interracial love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy! Faced with many difficulties, can their love prevail?

programme.title: WE 12
programme.desc: 12 elite members of an underground organization who possess extraordinary skills need to revive their team spirit and reunite to save the world from disaster.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archaeologist uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream, so he leads his team to a fantastical adventure into the glacier to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his abducted son from human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case.

programme.title: I Want to Be Rich
programme.desc: Born into poverty, Wah goes astray but has a kind heart. After meeting and falling in love with a Vietnamese woman Mei, he decides to rebuild his life and finally achieves his dream of wealth.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a B&B with a detective novelist, a drifter and a pianist. When the owner and receptionist turn up dead, every guest becomes both suspect and sleuth...

programme.title: The Monkey King 3
programme.desc: The Queen of Female Kingdom falls in love with Monk Tang, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be killed. As the River Spirit appears, the kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A Japanese security agent teams up with a master thief to recover counterfeit USD plates until a U.S. Embassy official betrays them and escapes to Korea with the prize.

programme.title: Shining for One Thing
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the exam. When an accident changes everything tragically, Zhang travels back in time. Can he amend things this time?

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Two sworn brothers become enemies after the girl they love marries one of them. The rivalry is only resolved when the property owner of their shops wants to terminate their tenancies 40 years later.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Down with ADHD, Xiao Xiao faces school bullies and family issues. Her teacher Paul is her solace, but when she witnesses a secret between her mother and Paul, it adds complexity to her emotions.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Kim is suffering from Alzheimer's disease but Ginger suspects that he is a film critic profiting from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger gets closer to him and uncovers his secrets and sorrows.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: Powerful, insane and obsessed with hatred, the bride with white hair has gone on a killing rampage, and can only be stopped by the one person she loves.

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: A high school student befriends a street punk as she copes with college entrance exam pressure and ruthless bullying. A murder investigation is set to alter both their lives.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: The Police sets up a special task force to track down a serial killer who leaves death notices stating when, how and who he will murder. In the process, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Hao Ren inherits the skills of Locksmith Shan and befriends Detective Liu who often seeks his help. When Hao Ren unveils the mystery of Shan's wife's disappearance one day, strange events ensue.

programme.title: Go For Broke
programme.desc: With his family destroyed by drug dealers, Zhang Yao teams up with detective An to take down the drug lords. As the revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas?

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles?

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who can enter a person's subconscious. As she investigates a murder-cum-suicide case, she finds herself under suspicion and comes face-to-face with a past trauma...

programme.title: We Girls
programme.desc: Gao is in prison as she steals to buy a cochlear implant for her daughter. She befriends 3 women there and upon release, they stand together to defy fate and support each other in life's challenges.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: A Pakistani refugee receive help from a taxi driver after his father died in a car crash. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the truth behind his father's death.

programme.title: Love is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: A year ago, Bo became blind in a serious car accident. One day, an intruder enters her house and takes her hostage. As she tries to survive, she discovers her husband's involvement in her accident!

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the City's protectors.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.

programme.title: Operation Mekong
programme.desc: Based on the Mekong River massacre, Zhang Han Yu & Eddie Peng star as members of a task force bent on bringing down a drug cartel, with Malaysia providing the backdrops for breath-taking action scenes.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards & featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: As a juror in a high-profile case learns that his daughter has been mysteriously kidnapped, he must decide whether to use his special skills to influence the trial as demanded by the kidnappers.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: When an unidentified corpse is found at a residential unit, the residents fear that its presence will turn their home into an ill-fated house, leading to a chaotic endeavor to remove the body.

programme.title: Come Back Home
programme.desc: De & family goes on a drive to Changbai Mountain, where their magical holiday turns tragic when their 8-year-old son goes missing. Will they be able to find him before the cold winter takes him?

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the family's criminal empire.

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: A veteran and a passionate street dancer both strive to reach their goals and pursue their dreams in street dancing. After overcoming many challenges, can they finally shine on stage?

programme.title: Hit N Fun
programme.desc: Ad executive Lin uncovers her boyfriend's affair with a champion boxer and challenges her to a match. Under the former boxing legend's training, her quest for revenge evolves into self-discovery.

programme.title: Love Never Ends
programme.desc: Two elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: LEIO
programme.desc: An ex-singer returns to his hometown & takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken town, only to discover a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground!

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his family's expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan resents their fraudulent ways. However, when fate shows him a route to redeeming their reputation, will he survive it?

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the family's criminal empire.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: In the second installment of Louis Chais famous novel, Wei Xiao Bao is trapped again between his responsibilities to the country or takes side to the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: The Way We Dance
programme.desc: When Fleur join her university's hip hop team, a journey begins which lead her into the heated world of dance competitions and a complicated romance.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis, his marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: Ultimate Malevolence
programme.desc: Featuring three stories about two high school friends, a magician and a lost man, the movie reveals the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Ready o/r Rot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi face pre-marital strife. Meanwhile, Grey Bear doubts his wife's fidelity and Ken faces a life crisis following his girlfriend's pregnancy. Can they resolve their relationship issues?

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: In this sequel to THE BULLET VANISHES, Sean Lau plays an inspector who is lead down a rabbit hole of discovery as he investigates a prison escape.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: A prisoner escaped under Master Zhang's custody, causing his expulsion. He sets off to find the prisoner, only to discover that the war between humans & demons have begun!

programme.desc: This family drama depicts Kwok Law Mei Lan, a mother who goes all out to help her three adult children who are burdened with problems, to free themselves - and find their way forward.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
